title: Spectrum Fiber Connections
summary: Just reminding residents that the 31st is next Friday, and Coax connections could be shutoff anytime after that. Please ensure that you have converted to the new Fiber Optic system. This will also help us get the coax cable lying on the ground removed, so grass cutters can do their jobs. Thank You, The HOPH Board
